source_version: Theory of Computing15(2019),Article10; final publisher source October21,2019
title: Fourier-level L1 bounds for low-degree binary phase polynomials

standard_prerequisites.name: Boolean Fourier analysis, random restrictions and elementary conditional probability
standard_prerequisites.statement: Original definitions and all local polarization, rounding or Fourier recurrence arguments retained.
standard_prerequisites.use: No collector reproof; applications/open problems remain their original scope.

core_obligations: The authors square level weights and control overlap terms using finite differences that lower polynomial degree, derive a simultaneous recurrence across degree and Fourier level, and close the bound by induction. The complete recurrence and derivative/overlap proof are retained. This is a structural Fourier bound, not a claimed PRG for low-degree polynomials; the authors explicitly say their bound is insufficient for that application.
